'''Krussk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] serving in the [[Trandoshan pirates|Trandoshan Pirates]] who led a group of fellow Trandoshan pirates in overtaking [[Bunker Krill]] during the [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|Battle of Umbara]].

==Biography==
Krussk, with his pirate band, attacked and partially overtook Bunker Krill owned by the [[Umbaran militia]] and their [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] allies during the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|invasion of Umbara]]. He held his position there until a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi Knight]] arrived and cleared the bunker of both the Trandoshan and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces.
